fields.why: Table 2 gives seroprevalence for each of 4 age and 5 race/ethnicity groups and the text ranks them; Table 1 reports one-way chi-square goodness-of-fit tests across the 4 age and 5 race levels.
Sex has only 2 tested levels (Other excluded from the test), so age and race/ethnicity are the groupwise dimensions.

The only race test is Black vs all other groups combined, a collapsed pair (rule 1), so the 5-group seroprevalence ranking is side by side with resolves_to_finer true rather than per-group vs referent only; the brief does not say whether one top-group-vs-rest test lifts a ranking to per-group vs referent. The goodness-of-fit omnibus entries are right under rule 6, and the age side-by-side flag is a false alarm (the omnibus test on age is the separate Table 1 entry).

brief_issues: Per-group vs referent only says it includes 'each level vs the rest' but not whether a single level vs the rest (here Black vs all others combined) counts or is a collapsed pair under rule 1; a rule is needed (suggest: one level vs the rest is a pair, and the ranking it accompanies is side by side with resolves_to_finer true).
